I'll compute forward, up, and right vectors in model space myself from the head's origin, then derive positions as combinations of these basis vectors to pass into `at`, `dir`, and `bone` parameters—computing right as the cross product of up and forward for consistency.

For building the head parts I'm thinking through using `frustumBox` for tapered sections like the upper snout and lower jaw, aligning each box's axis along the forward direction so the roll orientation stays consistent with world up.

Still sketching head geometry...
